summary: The WelcomeStudent file pertains to the initial interface for students in the HSPnet system, providing mechanisms for accessing various student-related functionalities such as placements, assessments, and personal information management.
purpose: To facilitate the entry point for students in managing their academic and placement records within HSPnet.

workflows.name: Student Tab Management
steps: Load student-specific data upon initial access.
Configure tab visibility based on student program and permissions.
Manage tab transitions and data refreshes based on user actions.

business_rules: Tabs are enabled based on student program settings.
Profiles should only display sections allowed by the student’s consent program.
Tabs should reflect real-time updates and reflect accurate information.
conditions: Tabs are conditionally displayed based on program attributes.
system_behavior: Displays student information and tools in a tabbed interface.
Tabs are dynamically loaded and updated based on student interactions.
Session management ensures correct tab updates.
